name: Draws artwork, activates Box Selection, manipulates 8-handle Free Transform gizmo with rotation and RotSprite bake
description: Verify drawing a shape on canvas, selecting it with Box Selection to reveal the floating transform gizmo HUD bar, rotating via Rotate 90 CW, flipping horizontally, and committing with the checkmark button.

planSteps.description: Verify the drawing studio workspace is loaded with center drawing canvas
Click the Ellipse tool button in the left toolbar
Click on the center drawing canvas to stamp an ellipse shape
Click the Select Box tool button in the left toolbar
Click and drag a selection marquee across the canvas over the drawn shape
Verify the Selection Transform Gizmo HUD bar appears displaying transform controls
Click the Flip Horizontal button on the transform HUD bar
Click the Rotate 90 CW button on the transform HUD bar
Click the Commit checkmark button on the transform HUD bar
Verify the transformation commits and the canvas workspace remains active
